targetTexts.2: “Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
targetTexts.3: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous? Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
targetTexts.4: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you?
targetTexts.5: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your iniquities endless?
targetTexts.6: For you needlessly demanded security from your brothers and deprived the naked of their clothing.
targetTexts.7: You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the famished,
targetTexts.8: while the land belonged to a mighty man, and a man of honor lived on it.
targetTexts.9: You sent widows away empty-handed, and the strength of the fatherless was crushed.
targetTexts.10: Therefore snares surround you, and sudden peril terrifies you;
targetTexts.11: it is so dark you cannot see, and a flood of water covers you.
targetTexts.12: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
targetTexts.13: Yet you say: ‘What does God know? Does He judge through thick darkness?
targetTexts.14: Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven.’
targetTexts.15: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod?
targetTexts.16: They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
targetTexts.17: They said to God, ‘Depart from us. What can the Almighty do to us?’
targetTexts.18: But it was He who filled their houses with good things; so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
targetTexts.19: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
targetTexts.20: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire has consumed their excess.’
targetTexts.21: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
targetTexts.22: Receive instruction from His mouth, and lay up His words in your heart.
targetTexts.23: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored. If you remove injustice from your tents
targetTexts.24: and consign your gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines,
targetTexts.25: then the Almighty will be your gold and the finest silver for you.
targetTexts.26: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
targetTexts.27: You will pray to Him, and He will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.
targetTexts.28: Your decisions will be carried out, and light will shine on your ways.
targetTexts.29: When men are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then He will save the lowly.
targetTexts.30: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands.”
